transcript: Talos Morrow appears to be a literary/theoretical heteronym rather than a conventional biographical author. The strongest evidence I found places Morrow inside the larger literary-technical project of poet and independent scholar Lee Sharks. According to the project's own provenance records: Talos Morrow is a registered heteronym in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, with a provenance DOI of 10.5281/zenodo.18317976. The archive identifies Morrow with 'Logotic Programming; operators; threshold logic.' [Medium +1] Morrow is associated with the fictional/institutional University Moon Base Media Lab (UMB), where the character's specialty is described as Logotic Programming—essentially the question of when meaning is allowed to move or remain intelligible. [Medium +1] Morrow is credited, alongside Johannes Sigil, as an author of Logotic Programming: A Method for [fold]
